title: Incident
summary: What happened, why, and the follow-ups the team commits to.

facets.label: Addresses
facets.hint: The contributing factor or moment in the timeline it answers.

facets.label: What changes
facets.hint: The action, concretely enough to start on.

facets.label: Done when
facets.hint: The check that proves the follow-up worked.

facets.label: Note
facets.hint: Anything the team must know that fits nowhere else.

sections.title: Impact
sections.hint: Who was affected, how badly, and for how long.

sections.title: Timeline
sections.hint: The events in order, with times.

sections.title: Contributing factors
sections.hint: Each factor in one line, with its evidence behind the fold.

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.hint: Every follow-up, grouped by detect, mitigate, and prevent.

legend: Effort is agent time, not calendar time: S is under an hour, M is a few hours with review, L is a day or more across sessions.

decision.title: How to commit
decision.markdown: Commit to follow-ups by number. Numbers without a word mean do.
decision.example: do 1, 2, 4; later 3. Notes: 3: after the winter timetable.
